answer: Locks are logged in pigment, expire in mirror, and thread lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 131 aliases therefore needs 111 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 716 identities would post 3594 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
